Welcome to 9to5Toys Midday Brief — the Prime Day post-sale special. Although the fall Prime Big Deal Days has wrapped up, Apple deals keep rolling in, and today we've curated the very best for you. Highlights include the lowest price ever on AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and the all-time low $150 off on the M6 Mac mini. The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 in multiple configurations remains at historical lows, M5 MacBook Air models are $200 off across the board, and official iPhone 18 Pro cases continue at all-time low pricing. Stick around for more great deals.

Sony BRAVIA TVs discounted up to $1,000 at Amazon — OLED, mini-LED and more

AirPods Pro 3 Prime Day deal still live at Amazon with nearly 30% off; AirPods Max 2 also holding at $120 off

Given the sheer volume of deals we covered yesterday, with Amazon wrapping up the fall Prime Day 2026, most products have returned to full price. Apple products, however, tell a very different story — AirPods Pro 3 is still at one of its lowest prices ever, and AirPods Max 2 is holding steady at $120 off.

As of writing, Amazon has the Apple AirPods Pro 3 available for $179 with free shipping.

This nearly 30% discount is one of the lowest prices we've tracked since this globally beloved earbud first launched.

Regularly $249, now $70 off — and how long this deal will last is anyone's guess. We've only ever seen a better price at Amazon once, the fleeting $169 deal during the 4-day summer Prime Day back in late June, which was extremely hard to come by.

  • AirPods Pro 3: $179 (regularly $249)
  • AirPods Max 2: $429 (regularly $549)

Apple's AirPods Max 2, launched earlier this year, is still holding at its fall Prime Day pricing — just like the Pro 3 above, we've only seen one lower price at Amazon ever; this offer sits just $30 above that all-time low seen only once since launch.

$120 off, with all five colours available for $429 with free shipping at Amazon — as for how long it will last, that's hard to say.

One of the most exciting Prime Day deals of the year is still live: up to $150 off the all-new M6 Mac mini

The fall Prime Day may officially be over, but as we reported earlier, plenty of 'lingering' deals remain (for now). One such deal is Apple's brand-new M6 Mac mini. As of writing, it's still up for grabs with up to $150 off — easily one of the most underrated steals of this Prime Day.

As of this morning, Amazon still has a solid lineup of Apple deals, though some are starting to disappear (mainly various Apple Watch Series 12 models). How long the M6 Mac mini discounts will last is anyone's guess, but they're still live this morning:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB: $780 (regularly $899) — just $11 from all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB: $950 (regularly $1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB: $1,150 (regularly $1,299) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB: $1,550 (regularly $1,699) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio: $2,300 (regularly $2,499) — all-time low

Here's the full lineup of all-new Apple Watch Series 12 models still at Prime Day all-time low prices

The fall Prime Day 2026 may have ended, but it's not quite over. Amazon is still offering holiday pricing on AirPods Pro 3, all-time low pricing on the M6 Mac mini, and deals across multiple Apple Watch Series 12 configurations. Below, we've rounded up every model still at its lowest price ever — some are starting to creep back up, so we'd recommend grabbing them soon.
